def raise_open_file_limit(want: int = 65536) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
    """Raise the soft limit on open files towards `want`, never above the hard limit. Every request in flight holds a
    client socket and an engine connection, and at the common default of 1,024 a busy server runs out: requests then
    fail with 502 (Too many open files) and asyncio logs a failed accept() in a tight loop. Returns (before, after),
    or None where the platform has no such limit."""
    try:
        import resource
    except ImportError:
        return None
    soft, hard = resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE)
    target = want if hard == resource.RLIM_INFINITY else min(want, hard)
    if soft == resource.RLIM_INFINITY or soft >= target:
        return soft, soft
    try:
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (target, hard))
    except (ValueError, OSError):
        return soft, soft
    return soft, target


def cmd_serve(a: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    from aiohttp import web

    from .pipeline import default_controls
    from .server import create_app

    limit = raise_open_file_limit()
    if limit and limit[1] != limit[0]:
        logging.info("open-file limit raised from %d to %d", *limit)
    if limit and limit[1] < 8192:
        logging.warning("open-file limit is %d: a busy server may fail with Too many open files; raise the hard "
                        "limit (ulimit -Hn, or LimitNOFILE in systemd)", limit[1])
    options, tls = _public_options(a)
    folder = load_model_folder(a.model)
    if folder.kind == "instant" and a.think_mode not in (None, "never"):
        raise SystemExit("this is an Instant folder: it does not think (drop --think-mode)")
    defaults = default_controls(folder, think_mode=a.think_mode, gate=a.gate, budget=a.think_budget, mix=a.mix,
                                thought_generation=a.thought_generation, none_check=not a.no_none_check,
                                allow_none=True if a.allow_none else None)
    max_budget = a.max_think_budget or defaults.budget
    if defaults.budget > max_budget:
        raise SystemExit(f"the default think budget {defaults.budget} is above --max-think-budget {max_budget}")
    tokenizer = load_tokenizer(a.model)
    name = a.name or os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(a.model))
    servers = None
    try:
        if a.backend == "vllm":
            from .backends.vllm import VLLMBackend
            urls = _urls(a.vllm_url)
            if a.launch_vllm:
                from .launch import VLLMServers
                servers = VLLMServers(a.model, a.gpus, a.vllm_base_port, log_dir=a.vllm_log_dir, python=a.vllm_python,
                                      max_model_len=a.max_model_len,
                                      gpu_memory_utilization=a.gpu_memory_utilization, quantization=a.quantization,
                                      mtp=not a.no_mtp, max_images=0 if a.no_images else a.max_images,
                                      max_pixels=a.max_pixels)
                logging.info("starting %d vLLM server(s), logs in %s; %s", len(a.gpus), a.vllm_log_dir,
                             servers.settings())
                servers.up(a.startup_timeout)
                urls = servers.urls
            if not urls:
                raise SystemExit("the vllm backend needs --vllm-url (running servers) or --launch-vllm")
            backend = VLLMBackend(urls, tokenizer, waves=a.waves, wave_max=a.wave_max, wave_gather=a.wave_gather,
                                  images=not a.no_images)
        elif a.backend == "transformers":
            from .backends.transformers import TransformersBackend
            backend = TransformersBackend(a.model, tokenizer, folder.bidirectional, a.device, a.dtype)
        elif a.backend == "llamacpp":
            from .backends.llamacpp import LlamaCppBackend
            backend = LlamaCppBackend(a.llamacpp_url, tokenizer, folder.bidirectional)
        else:
            from .backends.mlx import MLXBackend
            backend = MLXBackend(a.model, tokenizer, folder.bidirectional)
        images = {"max_images": 0 if a.no_images else a.max_images, "max_pixels": a.max_pixels}
        app = create_app(folder, backend, name, defaults, max_budget, a.max_model_len, options, images)
        scheme = "https" if tls else "http"
        web.run_app(app, host=a.host, port=a.port, access_log=None, ssl_context=tls,
                    print=lambda _: logging.info("%s serving on %s://%s:%d/v1/systemone", name, scheme, a.host, a.port))
    finally:
        if servers:
            servers.stop()
    return 0


def _public_options(a: argparse.Namespace) -> tuple:
    """(ServeOptions, TLS context or None) from the serving-publicly options; exits with the reason when one is
    unusable. Error messages name files and lines, never keys."""
    from .serving import (DECISION_PATHS, OPEN_PATHS, AccessLog, ApiKeys, RequestLog, ServeOptions, WatchedFile,
                          parse_models_document, tls_context)

    if bool(a.ssl_certfile) != bool(a.ssl_keyfile):
        raise SystemExit("--ssl-certfile and --ssl-keyfile go together")
    path = a.openrouter_models_path
    if not path.startswith("/") or path in DECISION_PATHS + OPEN_PATHS + ("/v1/models",):
        raise SystemExit(f"--openrouter-models-path {path!r} must start with / and not be a route of the API")
    try:
        options = ServeOptions(
            api_keys=ApiKeys(a.api_keys_file) if a.api_keys_file else None, max_inflight=a.max_inflight,
            models_document=WatchedFile(a.openrouter_models_file, parse_models_document, "OpenRouter models document")
            if a.openrouter_models_file else None, models_path=path,
            access_log=AccessLog(a.access_log) if a.access_log else None,
            request_log=RequestLog(a.request_log) if a.request_log else None)
        tls = tls_context(a.ssl_certfile, a.ssl_keyfile) if a.ssl_certfile else None
    except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
        raise SystemExit(f"cannot serve: {e}") from None
    return options, tls


def cmd_launch(a: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    from .launch import VLLMServers, launch_variables

    servers = VLLMServers(a.model, a.gpus, a.base_port, a.host, a.log_dir, a.python, a.served_model_name,
                          a.max_model_len, a.gpu_memory_utilization, a.quantization, mtp=not a.no_mtp,
                          max_images=0 if a.no_images else a.max_images, max_pixels=a.max_pixels)
    print(servers.settings(), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    if a.dry_run:
        for gpu, (cmd, _) in zip(a.gpus, servers.plan()):
            variables = launch_variables(gpu, servers.bidirectional)
            print(" ".join([f"{k}={variables[k]}" for k in sorted(variables)] + [shlex.join(cmd)]))
        return 0
    servers.up(a.startup_timeout)
    print("vLLM servers ready: " + ",".join(servers.urls), flush=True)
    print(f"serve with: startlux-decide serve --model {a.model} --vllm-url {','.join(servers.urls)}", flush=True)
    try:
        while all(p.poll() is None for p in servers.procs):
            time.sleep(2)
        dead = [i for i, p in enumerate(servers.procs) if p.poll() is not None]
        print(f"vLLM server(s) {dead} exited; stopping the others", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        return 0
    finally:
        servers.stop()


def _print_table(rows: list[dict]) -> None:
    print(f"{'metric':<22}{'n':>6}{'mean':>12}{'median':>12}{'p80':>12}{'p95':>12}")
    for r in rows:
        print(f"{r['metric']:<22}{r['n']:>6}{r['mean']:>12.1f}{r['median']:>12.1f}{r['p80']:>12.1f}{r['p95']:>12.1f}")


def cmd_bench(a: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    from .bench import METRICS, ROW_FIELDS, bench, read_jsonl, summarize, write_csv

    items = read_jsonl(a.requests)
    rows = asyncio.run(bench(a.url, items, a.concurrency, a.warmup, a.timeout, a.controls))
    summary = summarize(rows, METRICS)
    write_csv(a.out, summary, ("metric", "n", "mean", "median", "p80", "p95"))
    if a.rows:
        write_csv(a.rows, rows, ROW_FIELDS)
    failed = sum(r["status"] != "ok" for r in rows)
    print(f"{len(rows)} requests, {failed} failed, concurrency {a.concurrency}")
    _print_table(summary)
    return 1 if failed else 0


def cmd_eval(a: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    from . import evaluate as E
    from .bench import read_jsonl

    if a.compare:
        out = E.compare(read_jsonl(a.compare[0]), read_jsonl(a.compare[1]), a.resamples)
    elif a.score:
        out = E.score(read_jsonl(a.score))
    else:
        if not a.data or not a.out:
            raise SystemExit("eval needs --data and --out (or --score / --compare)")
        records = asyncio.run(E.run(a.url, read_jsonl(a.data), a.concurrency, a.timeout, a.controls))
        E.write_jsonl(a.out, records)
        out = E.score(records)
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
    return 0


def cmd_quantize(a: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    from . import quantize as Q

    if a.method == "fp8":
        print(Q.fp8_advice(a.model))
        return 0
    if not a.out:
        raise SystemExit(f"quantize {a.method} needs --out")
    if a.method == "gguf":
        if not a.llama_cpp:
            raise SystemExit("quantize gguf needs --llama-cpp (a llama.cpp checkout with a build of llama-quantize)")
        cmds, problems = Q.gguf_plan(a.model, a.out, a.llama_cpp, a.type)
        after = (f"serve: llama-server -m {a.out}/model-{a.type}.gguf -ngl 99 -c 65536 --port 8081\n"
                 f"       startlux-decide serve --model {a.out} --backend llamacpp "
                 "--llamacpp-url http://127.0.0.1:8081")
    else:
        cmds, problems = Q.mlx_plan(a.model, a.out, a.bits)
        after = f"serve: startlux-decide serve --model {a.out} --backend mlx"
    for cmd in cmds:
        print(" ".join(cmd))
    print(f"then copy the tokenizer and config files of {a.model} that are missing in {a.out}")
    print(after)
    for problem in problems:
        print("missing: " + problem, file=sys.stderr)
    if a.run:
        if problems:
            return 1
        if a.method == "gguf":
            os.makedirs(a.out, exist_ok=True)
        Q.run(cmds)
        print("copied: " + ", ".join(Q.copy_folder_files(a.model, a.out)))
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
    a = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    commands = {"serve": cmd_serve, "launch-vllm": cmd_launch, "bench": cmd_bench, "eval": cmd_eval,
                "quantize": cmd_quantize}
    return commands[a.command](a)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())



================================================
FILE: startlux_decide/controls.py
================================================
"""Per-request controls of /v1/systemone: optional top-level fields next to ``state`` and ``questions``.

    think_mode       "auto" | "never" | "always" ("hybrid", "plain", "think" are accepted as older names)
    gate             in [0, 1]: think when the first read-out's top probability is below it
    think_budget     integer >= 1: most thought tokens (capped by the server's maximum)
    mix              in [0, 1]: final = (1 - mix) * first read-out + mix * read-out after the thought
    allow_none       bool: choice questions get the extra last option "None of the above", and "choice" is null when
                     it is the most likely one (a question's own "allow_none" overrides it; other types ignore it)
    none_check       bool: choice questions get the extra last option internally and report "none_probability", but
                     "choice" stays a listed option unless allow_none is set (serve turns it on by default)
    return_details   bool: add per-answer details and per-request timings
    return_thought   bool: also return the thought text (implies return_details)
    thought_generation  "auto" | "stream" | "chunked": how a thought is generated (pipeline.py); "auto" streams on
                     engines that stream thoughts safely (vLLM 0.31 or later), "stream" is refused on the others

A missing field takes the server default. Instant models never think: a request that asks them to (think_mode
"auto" or "always") is refused.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
from typing import Any

from .modelcfg import think_mode

THOUGHT_GENERATIONS = ("auto", "stream", "chunked")
STREAM_REFUSED = ("this engine does not stream thoughts (vLLM 0.31 or later does): leave thought_generation out or "
                  "set it to \"chunked\"")


class RequestError(ValueError):
    """A request the server refuses (422), with the location of the offending field."""

    def __init__(self, message: str, loc: tuple = ("body",)):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.loc = list(loc)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Controls:
    """The effective controls of one request."""
    think_mode: str = "auto"
    gate: float = 0.6
    budget: int = 4096
    mix: float = 0.75
    details: bool = False
    thought_text: bool = False
    thought_generation: str = "auto"
    allow_none: bool = False
    none_check: bool = False


def _fraction(value: Any, name: str) -> float:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not (math.isfinite(value) and 0 <= value <= 1):
        raise RequestError(f"{name} must be a number from 0 to 1, not {value!r}", ("body", name))
    return float(value)


def _flag(value: Any, name: str) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(value, bool):
        raise RequestError(f"{name} must be true or false, not {value!r}", ("body", name))
    return value


def parse_controls(body: dict, defaults: Controls, max_budget: int, can_think: bool,
                   can_stream: bool = False) -> Controls:
    """The controls of a request body on top of the server defaults; raises RequestError for bad values.
    `can_stream`: the engine streams thoughts (else thought_generation "stream" is refused)."""
    out = defaults
    if body.get("think_mode") is not None:
        try:
            out = replace(out, think_mode=think_mode(body["think_mode"]))
        except ValueError as e:
            raise RequestError(str(e), ("body", "think_mode")) from None
        if not can_think and out.think_mode != "never":
            raise RequestError("this is an Instant model: it answers in one pass and does not think; leave think_mode "
                               "out or set it to \"never\" (thinking needs an AutoThink model)",
                               ("body", "think_mode"))
    if body.get("gate") is not None:
        out = replace(out, gate=_fraction(body["gate"], "gate"))
    if body.get("mix") is not None:
        out = replace(out, mix=_fraction(body["mix"], "mix"))
    if body.get("think_budget") is not None:
        b = body["think_budget"]
        if isinstance(b, bool) or not isinstance(b, int) or b < 1:
            raise RequestError(f"think_budget must be an integer of at least 1, not {b!r}", ("body", "think_budget"))
        out = replace(out, budget=min(b, max_budget))
    if body.get("allow_none") is not None:
        out = replace(out, allow_none=_flag(body["allow_none"], "allow_none"))
    if body.get("none_check") is not None:
        out = replace(out, none_check=_flag(body["none_check"], "none_check"))
    if body.get("return_details") is not None:
        out = replace(out, details=_flag(body["return_details"], "return_details"))
    if body.get("return_thought") is not None:
        out = replace(out, thought_text=_flag(body["return_thought"], "return_thought"))
        out = replace(out, details=out.details or out.thought_text)
    if body.get("thought_generation") is not None:
        g = body["thought_generation"]
        if g not in THOUGHT_GENERATIONS:
            raise RequestError(f"thought_generation must be one of {', '.join(THOUGHT_GENERATIONS)}, not {g!r}",
                               ("body", "thought_generation"))
        if g == "stream" and not can_stream:
            raise RequestError(STREAM_REFUSED, ("body", "thought_generation"))
        out = replace(out, thought_generation=g)
    return out



================================================
FILE: startlux_decide/evaluate.py
================================================
"""Accuracy and calibration of a decision server on gold-labelled requests, and the paired comparison of two runs
(for example BF16 against an FP8, GGUF or MLX build of the same model).

Input: JSONL, one request per line: {"id" (optional), "state", "questions", "gold": {question key: label}} where the
label is an option id for a choice, true/false (or "yes"/"no") for a yes/no question, and the level index (0 =
lowest) or a criteria key for a score. Questions without a gold label are sent but not scored.

Per question: predicted label = the choice / yes when P(yes) >= 0.5 / the most probable level; confidence = the
probability of the predicted label. Metrics: accuracy; ECE (top-label, 10 equal-width confidence bins, weighted by
bin size); Brier score (sum over the options of (p - 1[gold])^2, so a yes/no question counts both options); the share
of questions that thought and the mean thought tokens (from the answers' details).

Comparison (pairs of the same request id and question key with the same gold label): agreement of the predicted
labels, accuracy of each run, the difference B - A with a 95% bootstrap interval that resamples requests (questions of
one request share their evidence), agreement of the gate's decisions, and the largest change of any option's
probability per question (mean and max over questions).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import random
from typing import Any, Sequence

from .bench import percentile, post_all, request_body
from .prompt import score_keys

ECE_BINS = 10


def gold_label(spec: dict, gold: Any) -> str:
    """The gold label of a question in the form predicted labels take; raises ValueError."""
    t = spec.get("type", "choice")
    crit = spec.get("criteria", spec.get("options"))
    if t in ("noul", "bool"):
        mapping = {True: "true", False: "false", "true": "true", "false": "false", "yes": "true", "no": "false",
                   1: "true", 0: "false"}
        key = gold.lower() if isinstance(gold, str) else gold
        if key not in mapping:
            raise ValueError(f"a yes/no gold label must be true or false, not {gold!r}")
        return mapping[key]
    if t == "score":
        n = len(crit or [])
        if isinstance(gold, str) and isinstance(crit, dict) and gold in crit:
            return str(score_keys(crit).index(gold))
        if isinstance(gold, int) and not isinstance(gold, bool) and 0 <= gold < n:
            return str(gold)
        raise ValueError(f"a score gold label must be a level index 0..{n - 1} or a criteria key, not {gold!r}")
    options = [str(c) for c in crit] if isinstance(crit, (list, tuple, dict)) else []
    if str(gold) not in options:
        raise ValueError(f"the gold label {gold!r} is not an option of the question")
    return str(gold)


def prediction(question_type: str, answer: dict) -> tuple[str, dict]:
    """(predicted label, {label: probability}) of an answer."""
    if question_type in ("noul", "bool"):
        p = answer["noul"]
        return ("true" if p >= 0.5 else "false"), {"true": p, "false": 1 - p}
    probs = answer["probabilities"]
    if question_type == "score":
        return max(probs, key=probs.get), probs
    return answer["choice"], probs


def record(item: dict, index: int) -> dict:
    """A line of a predictions file before the answer: the request id, every question's type and gold label."""
    gold = item.get("gold") or {}
    questions = {}
    for key, spec in item["questions"].items():
        try:
            label = gold_label(spec, gold[key]) if gold.get(key) is not None else None
        except ValueError as e:
            raise ValueError(f"request {item.get('id', index)}, question {key}: {e}") from None
        questions[key] = {"type": spec.get("type", "choice"), "gold": label}
    return {"id": item.get("id", index), "status": "pending", "questions": questions}


async def run(url: str, items: Sequence[dict], concurrency: int = 8, timeout: float = 3600.0,
              controls: dict | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    """Send every item (with return_details) and return the prediction records. Every gold label is checked before
    anything is sent."""
    records = [record(it, i) for i, it in enumerate(items)]
    results = await post_all(url, [request_body(it, controls) for it in items], concurrency, timeout)
    for rec, (status, _, response, err) in zip(records, results):
        rec["status"] = status
        if response:
            rec["answers"], rec["timing_ms"] = response["answers"], response.get("timing_ms")
        if err:
            rec["error"] = err
    return records


def _rows(records: Sequence[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    """One row per scored question: request id, key, gold, predicted label, probabilities, thought."""
    rows = []
    for rec in records:
        for key, q in rec["questions"].items():
            if q["gold"] is None or rec["status"] != "ok":
                continue
            ans = rec["answers"][key]
            pred, probs = prediction(q["type"], ans)
            thought = (ans.get("details") or {}).get("thought") or {}
            rows.append({"id": rec["id"], "key": key, "type": q["type"], "gold": q["gold"], "pred": pred,
                         "probs": probs, "thought": thought.get("used"), "tokens": thought.get("tokens", 0)})
    return rows


def score(records: Sequence[dict]) -> dict:
    """Metrics of one predictions file (see the module docstring)."""
    rows = _rows(records)
    out = {"requests": len(records), "failed_requests": sum(r["status"] != "ok" for r in records),
           "questions": len(rows)}
    if not rows:
        return out
    bins = [[0, 0.0, 0.0] for _ in range(ECE_BINS)]           # count, sum of confidence, correct
    brier = 0.0
    for r in rows:
        conf, ok = r["probs"][r["pred"]], r["pred"] == r["gold"]
        b = bins[min(int(conf * ECE_BINS), ECE_BINS - 1)]
        b[0], b[1], b[2] = b[0] + 1, b[1] + conf, b[2] + ok
        brier += sum((p - (label == r["gold"])) ** 2 for label, p in r["probs"].items())
        brier += 0.0 if r["gold"] in r["probs"] else 1.0
    n = len(rows)
    out.update({"accuracy": 100 * sum(r["pred"] == r["gold"] for r in rows) / n,
                "ece": 100 * sum(abs(c - k) for _, c, k in bins) / n, "brier": brier / n})
    with_details = [r for r in rows if r["thought"] is not None]
    if with_details:
        thinking = [r for r in with_details if r["thought"]]
        out.update({"thought_share": 100 * len(thinking) / len(with_details),
                    "thought_tokens_mean": sum(r["tokens"] for r in with_details) / len(with_details),
                    "thought_tokens_mean_when_thinking": (sum(r["tokens"] for r in thinking) / len(thinking)
                                                          if thinking else 0.0)})
    by_type = {}
    for t in sorted({r["type"] for r in rows}):
        sub = [r for r in rows if r["type"] == t]
        by_type[t] = {"questions": len(sub), "accuracy": 100 * sum(r["pred"] == r["gold"] for r in sub) / len(sub)}
    out["by_type"] = by_type
    return out


def compare(a: Sequence[dict], b: Sequence[dict], resamples: int = 2000, seed: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Paired comparison of two predictions files of the same requests (see the module docstring)."""
    rows_a = {(r["id"], r["key"]): r for r in _rows(a)}
    pairs = [(ra, rb) for rb in _rows(b) for ra in [rows_a.get((rb["id"], rb["key"]))]
             if ra is not None and ra["gold"] == rb["gold"]]
    if not pairs:
        return {"paired_questions": 0}
    n = len(pairs)
    clusters: dict = {}
    for ra, rb in pairs:
        c = clusters.setdefault(ra["id"], [0, 0, 0])
        c[0] += ra["pred"] == ra["gold"]
        c[1] += rb["pred"] == rb["gold"]
        c[2] += 1
    acc_a = 100 * sum(c[0] for c in clusters.values()) / n
    acc_b = 100 * sum(c[1] for c in clusters.values()) / n
    rng, cl, diffs = random.Random(seed), list(clusters.values()), []
    for _ in range(resamples):
        draw = [cl[rng.randrange(len(cl))] for _ in cl]
        m = sum(c[2] for c in draw)
        diffs.append(100 * (sum(c[1] for c in draw) - sum(c[0] for c in draw)) / m)
    dp = [max(abs(ra["probs"].get(k, 0.0) - rb["probs"].get(k, 0.0)) for k in set(ra["probs"]) | set(rb["probs"]))
          for ra, rb in pairs]
    gated = [(ra, rb) for ra, rb in pairs if ra["thought"] is not None and rb["thought"] is not None]
    out = {"paired_questions": n, "paired_requests": len(clusters),
           "agreement": 100 * sum(ra["pred"] == rb["pred"] for ra, rb in pairs) / n,
           "accuracy_a": acc_a, "accuracy_b": acc_b, "accuracy_diff_b_minus_a": acc_b - acc_a,
           "accuracy_diff_ci95": [percentile(diffs, 2.5), percentile(diffs, 97.5)],
           "both_correct": sum(ra["pred"] == ra["gold"] and rb["pred"] == rb["gold"] for ra, rb in pairs),
           "only_a_correct": sum(ra["pred"] == ra["gold"] and rb["pred"] != rb["gold"] for ra, rb in pairs),
           "only_b_correct": sum(ra["pred"] != ra["gold"] and rb["pred"] == rb["gold"] for ra, rb in pairs),
           "mean_max_abs_dp": sum(dp) / n, "max_abs_dp": max(dp)}
    if gated:
        out["thought_agreement"] = 100 * sum(ra["thought"] == rb["thought"] for ra, rb in gated) / len(gated)
    return out


def write_jsonl(path: str, records: Sequence[dict]) -> None:
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in records:
            f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")



================================================
FILE: startlux_decide/images.py
================================================
"""Images in a request's evidence, as in v1: a top-level "images" list of base64 strings or data URIs, and "<image>"
marks in the state that say where each image goes.

* ``place_images(state, n)``: the state as text with the place of every image. A string state (or the text of a JSON
  state) with exactly n "<image>" marks gets an image at each mark, in order; without marks the images come first
  (one image alone, several as "Image 1: ...", "Image 2: ..." on their own lines), then a blank line and the state.
* ``Media``: the decoded images of one request. Each image is resized by the engine's image processor so that both
  sides are multiples of 32 pixels (16-pixel patches, 2 x 2 merged) and it has between `min_pixels` (65,536) and
  `max_pixels` (1,048,576) pixels, keeping its aspect ratio (``smart_resize``, the rule of the processor); it then
  takes one token per 32 x 32 pixels, so a 1024 x 1024 photo is 1,024 tokens. The package computes that size itself,
  for its token counts, and the engines resize with the same bounds.

In a rendered prompt an image is the placeholder of the folder's chat template (``IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER``); the engine
puts the image's tokens there.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import binascii
import io
import math
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Sequence

IMAGE_MARK = "<image>"                      # in a string state: where the next image goes
SLOT = "\x00IMAGE\x00"                      # an image's place in a rendered question, before the chat template
IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER = "<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>"   # an image in the chat template's output
IMAGE_PAD = "<|image_pad|>"                 # the token the engine replaces by the image's tokens
FACTOR = 32                                 # pixels per image token side: 16-pixel patches, merged 2 x 2
MIN_PIXELS = 65536
MAX_PIXELS = 1 << 20
MAX_IMAGES = 16                             # images in one request (serve --max-images)
_DATA_URI = re.compile(r"^data:(image/[\w.+-]+)?(;[\w=.+-]+)*;base64,", re.I)


def place_images(text: str, n: int) -> str:
    """The state text with the place of n images (module docstring); raises ValueError when the marks do not match."""
    marks = text.count(IMAGE_MARK)
    if marks == n:
        return text.replace(IMAGE_MARK, SLOT)
    if marks:
        raise ValueError(f"the state has {marks} {IMAGE_MARK} marks for {n} images")
    head = SLOT if n == 1 else "\n".join(f"Image {k + 1}: {SLOT}" for k in range(n))
    return head + ("\n\n" + text if text.strip() else "")


def smart_resize(height: int, width: int, factor: int = FACTOR, min_pixels: int = MIN_PIXELS,
                 max_pixels: int = MAX_PIXELS) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """The size the image processor of these models resizes an image to (transformers' Qwen2-VL smart_resize): both
    sides multiples of `factor`, between min_pixels and max_pixels pixels, close to the original aspect ratio."""
    if max(height, width) / min(height, width) > 200:
        raise ValueError(f"an image's sides may differ by a factor of 200 at most, not {height} x {width}")
    h = round(height / factor) * factor
    w = round(width / factor) * factor
    if h * w > max_pixels:
        beta = math.sqrt((height * width) / max_pixels)
        h = max(factor, math.floor(height / beta / factor) * factor)
        w = max(factor, math.floor(width / beta / factor) * factor)
    elif h * w < min_pixels:
        beta = math.sqrt(min_pixels / (height * width))
        h = math.ceil(height * beta / factor) * factor
        w = math.ceil(width * beta / factor) * factor
    return h, w


def decode(value: Any) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
    """A base64 string or a data URI -> (the encoded image bytes, its MIME type from the URI or "")."""
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError(f"an image must be a base64 string or a data URI, not {type(value).__name__}")
    m = _DATA_URI.match(value)
    mime = (m.group(1) or "").lower() if m else ""
    payload = value[m.end():] if m else value
    try:
        return base64.b64decode(re.sub(r"\s+", "", payload), validate=True), mime
    except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
        raise ValueError("an image must be a base64 string or a data URI") from None


@dataclass
class Media:
    """The images of one request: the encoded bytes as sent, the decoded RGB images (PIL), their sizes after the
    processor's resize and their token counts."""
    raw: list = field(default_factory=list)          # (bytes, MIME type)
    images: list = field(default_factory=list)       # PIL images, RGB, original size
    sizes: list = field(default_factory=list)        # (height, width) after the resize
    tokens: list = field(default_factory=list)       # image tokens per image
    min_pixels: int = MIN_PIXELS
    max_pixels: int = MAX_PIXELS
    _uris: list | None = None

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self.images)

    def data_uris(self) -> list[str]:
        """Every image as a data URI of its original bytes (what an OpenAI-style server is sent)."""
        if self._uris is None:
            self._uris = [f"data:{mime or 'image/png'};base64,{base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii')}"
                          for raw, mime in self.raw]
        return self._uris

    @property
    def processor_size(self) -> dict:
        """The resize bounds in the form of the image processor's `size` setting."""
        return {"longest_edge": self.max_pixels, "shortest_edge": self.min_pixels}


def load_media(values: Sequence[Any], min_pixels: int = MIN_PIXELS, max_pixels: int = MAX_PIXELS,
               max_images: int = MAX_IMAGES, factor: int = FACTOR) -> Media:
    """Decode the images of a request (base64 strings or data URIs); raises ValueError for anything unreadable."""
    try:
        from PIL import Image, UnidentifiedImageError
    except ImportError:
        raise ValueError("this server cannot read images: install Pillow") from None
    if not isinstance(values, (list, tuple)):
        raise ValueError("images must be a list of base64 strings or data URIs")
    if len(values) > max_images:
        raise ValueError(f"at most {max_images} images per request, not {len(values)}")
    media = Media(min_pixels=min_pixels, max_pixels=max_pixels)
    for k, value in enumerate(values):
        raw, mime = decode(value)
        try:
            img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw))
            fmt = (img.format or "").lower()
            img = img.convert("RGB")
        except (UnidentifiedImageError, OSError) as e:
            raise ValueError(f"image {k + 1} is not a readable image ({e})") from None
        h, w = smart_resize(img.height, img.width, factor, min_pixels, max_pixels)
        media.raw.append((raw, mime or (f"image/{fmt}" if fmt else "")))
        media.images.append(img)
        media.sizes.append((h, w))
        media.tokens.append((h // factor) * (w // factor))
    return media


def multimodal_messages(msgs: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    """Chat messages whose contents hold SLOT marks -> the same messages with content parts (text and image), the
    form the chat template renders images from."""
    out = []
    for m in msgs:
        content = m["content"]
        if not isinstance(content, str):
            out.append(m)
            continue
        parts = []
        for k, piece in enumerate(content.split(SLOT)):
            if k:
                parts.append({"type": "image"})
            if piece:
                parts.append({"type": "text", "text": piece})
        out.append({**m, "content": parts})
    return out


def split_prompt(prompt: str) -> list[str]:
    """A rendered prompt -> its text between the image placeholders (one more piece than images)."""
    return prompt.split(IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER)


# The chat template the vLLM client sends with an image request: it writes the parts of the already rendered prompt
# back to back and the placeholder for each image, so the engine reads exactly the package's prompt.
PASS_THROUGH_TEMPLATE = (
    "{%- for message in messages -%}"
    "{%- if message['content'] is string -%}{{ message['content'] }}{%- else -%}"
    "{%- for part in message['content'] -%}"
    "{%- if part['type'] == 'text' -%}{{ part['text'] }}{%- else -%}" + IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER + "{%- endif -%}"
    "{%- endfor -%}{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%}")



================================================
FILE: startlux_decide/launch.py
================================================
"""Start vLLM OpenAI-compatible servers for a model folder, one per GPU, with the flags of the release runs.

Why each flag (docs/engines.md has the details):

* ``--logprobs-mode processed_logprobs --max-logprobs 26``: the read-out asks for the log-probabilities of up to 26
  allowed letters; processed log-probabilities are taken after the allowed-token mask, so all of them come back.
* ``--generation-config vllm``: otherwise the folder's generation_config (top_k, top_p) is applied to the read-out
  and cuts letters off.
* ``--max-model-len``: on vLLM 0.31 or later the folder's native context (``max_position_embeddings``, 262,144 tokens
  in these folders) for causal folders, and 131,072 for Instant folders, unless set lower; on 0.19.1, and when the
  folder does not say, 65,536 (the release setting). An Instant prompt is prefilled in one step, and on vLLM 0.31 a
  step of a 196,000-token prompt (27B) or a 256,000-token prompt (4B) crashed the server (an illegal memory access;
  128,000 tokens ran at both sizes). A longer ``--max-model-len`` can be set, at that risk.
* Images (vLLM 0.31 or later, folders with a vision tower, unless switched off): ``--limit-mm-per-prompt
  '{"image":N,"video":0}'`` (N = most images per request, 8 by default), ``--mm-processor-kwargs`` with the resize
  bounds (at most 1,048,576 pixels per image) and ``--trust-request-chat-template`` (image calls carry the client's
  pass-through template). Otherwise ``--limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":0,"video":0}'``: text only, and no memory for
  the vision tower's inputs. Instant servers with images also get ``--skip-mm-profiling``: vLLM profiles the image
  encoder with as many full-size images as one step holds (256 when a step holds 262,144 tokens); with that profile
  the 4B Instant server did not start (an illegal memory access in the profile run), without it the server started
  and read image requests.

Prefix caching, chunked prefill and speculative decoding depend on the vLLM version and the folder:

* vLLM 0.19.1 (and any folder on a vLLM older than 0.31, or whose version cannot be read):
  ``--no-enable-prefix-caching --no-enable-chunked-prefill`` and ``--max-num-batched-tokens`` = ``--max-model-len``.
  On 0.19.1 both change answers of these hybrid models silently (prefix caching moved 2.6% of ordinary and 16% of
  wide-list read-outs by more than 0.05 in our tests); a whole prompt fits in one step.
* AutoThink (causal) folders on vLLM 0.31 or later: ``--enable-prefix-caching --enable-chunked-prefill
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192``. On 0.31 prefix caching works on these hybrid models only together with chunked
  prefill; with both on, the 27B AutoThink model gave the same answer as on 0.19.1 for 99.88% of 823 questions. When the
  folder holds MTP weights (mtp.* tensors and ``mtp_num_hidden_layers`` in config.json), the servers also get MTP
  speculative decoding with 3 draft tokens (``--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'``):
  the thoughts keep their length distribution and are generated faster. ``mtp=False`` switches it off.
* Instant (prompt-bidirectional) folders, on every version: both off and no speculative decoding, because the plugin
  needs every prompt prefilled whole in one step (``--max-num-batched-tokens`` = ``--max-model-len``: one step may
  hold a prompt of the full context). The servers get STARTLUX_PREFIX_BIDIR=1, and the launcher refuses to go on
  unless every server log shows that the plugin is active.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from .backends.vllm import STREAM_VERSION, parse_version
from .images import MAX_PIXELS, MIN_PIXELS
from .modelcfg import native_context, read_config, read_prompt_attention, vision_settings
from .vllm_plugin import ACTIVE_LINE, ENV, PLUGIN_NAME

MAX_MODEL_LEN = 65536               # when the folder does not give its native context
GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION = 0.88
INSTANT_MAX_MODEL_LEN = 131072      # default context of Instant servers on vLLM 0.31 or later (module docstring)
CACHED_BATCHED_TOKENS = 8192        # --max-num-batched-tokens with chunked prefill (vLLM 0.31 or later)
MTP_DRAFT_TOKENS = 3                # MTP speculative decoding: draft tokens per step
MAX_IMAGES = 8                      # images per request a server takes (launch --max-images)


def server_command(python: str, model: str, port: int, host: str = "127.0.0.1", served_name: str = "m",
                   max_model_len: int = MAX_MODEL_LEN, gpu_memory_utilization: float = GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION,
                   quantization: str | None = None, prefix_caching: bool = False, mtp_tokens: int = 0,
                   images: int = 0, max_pixels: int = MAX_PIXELS) -> list[str]:
    """The command line of one vLLM server with the release flags. `prefix_caching`: prefix caching and chunked
    prefill on (AutoThink folders on vLLM 0.31 or later), else both off; `mtp_tokens` > 0: MTP speculative
    decoding with that many draft tokens; `images` > 0: that many images per request, resized to at most
    `max_pixels` pixels (else text only)."""
    cmd = [python, "-m", "vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server", "--model", model, "--served-model-name", served_name,
           "--host", host, "--port", str(port), "--max-model-len", str(max_model_len),
           "--gpu-memory-utilization", str(gpu_memory_utilization), "--logprobs-mode", "processed_logprobs",
           "--max-logprobs", "26", "--generation-config", "vllm"]
    if prefix_caching:
        cmd += ["--enable-prefix-caching", "--enable-chunked-prefill", "--max-num-batched-tokens",
                str(CACHED_BATCHED_TOKENS)]
    else:
        cmd += ["--no-enable-prefix-caching", "--no-enable-chunked-prefill", "--max-num-batched-tokens",
                str(max_model_len)]
    cmd += ["--limit-mm-per-prompt", json.dumps({"image": images, "video": 0}, separators=(",", ":"))]
    if images:
        size = {"size": {"longest_edge": max_pixels, "shortest_edge": MIN_PIXELS}}
        cmd += ["--mm-processor-kwargs", json.dumps(size, separators=(",", ":")), "--trust-request-chat-template"]
        if not prefix_caching:              # a step may hold a whole prompt: see the module docstring
            cmd += ["--skip-mm-profiling"]
    cmd += ["--disable-uvicorn-access-log"]
    if mtp_tokens:
        cmd += ["--speculative-config",
                json.dumps({"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": mtp_tokens}, separators=(",", ":"))]
    if quantization:
        cmd += ["--quantization", quantization]
    return cmd


def vllm_version(python: str) -> str | None:
    """The vLLM version installed for `python` (read from its package metadata; vLLM is not imported). None when
    vLLM is not installed there."""
    code = "import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version('vllm'))"
    try:
        r = subprocess.run([python, "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return None
    return (r.stdout.strip() or None) if r.returncode == 0 else None


def has_mtp_weights(model: str) -> bool:
    """True when the folder declares MTP layers (``mtp_num_hidden_layers`` >= 1 in config.json, top level or
    text_config) and holds their weights (``mtp.*`` tensors in model.safetensors.index.json, or in model.safetensors
    for a single-file folder)."""
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(model, "config.json")) as f:
            cfg = json.load(f)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return False
    layers = (cfg.get("text_config") or {}).get("mtp_num_hidden_layers", cfg.get("mtp_num_hidden_layers")) or 0
    if not isinstance(layers, int) or layers < 1:
        return False
    names: list = []
    index = os.path.join(model, "model.safetensors.index.json")
    single = os.path.join(model, "model.safetensors")
    try:
        if os.path.isfile(index):
            with open(index) as f:
                names = list((json.load(f).get("weight_map") or {}))
        elif os.path.isfile(single):
            with open(single, "rb") as f:
                size = int.from_bytes(f.read(8), "little")
                names = list(json.loads(f.read(size)))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return False
    return any(n.startswith("mtp.") for n in names)


def launch_variables(gpu: str, bidirectional: bool) -> dict:
    """The variables the launcher sets for one server: its GPU, no usage statistics, the plugin switch."""
    out = {"CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": gpu, "VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS": "1"}
    if bidirectional:
        out[ENV] = "1"
    return out


def server_env(gpu: str, bidirectional: bool, base: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Environment of one server: `base` (default: this process's) with the launch variables."""
    env = dict(os.environ if base is None else base)
    env.update(launch_variables(gpu, bidirectional))
    if bidirectional:
        plugins = env.get("VLLM_PLUGINS")
        if plugins is not None and PLUGIN_NAME not in [p.strip() for p in plugins.split(",")]:
            raise RuntimeError(f"VLLM_PLUGINS is set to {plugins!r} without {PLUGIN_NAME}; vLLM would not load the "
                               "prompt-bidirectional plugin")
    return env


def plugin_visible(python: str) -> bool:
    """True when the Python that runs vLLM sees this package's vLLM plugin entry point."""
    group = "vllm.general_plugins"
    code = ("import importlib.metadata as m, sys; eps = m.entry_points(); "
            f"g = eps.select(group={group!r}) if hasattr(eps, 'select') else eps.get({group!r}, []); "
            f"sys.exit(0 if any(e.name == {PLUGIN_NAME!r} for e in g) else 1)")
    return subprocess.run([python, "-c", code], capture_output=True).returncode == 0


def plugin_problem(log_text: str) -> str | None:
    """None when a server log shows the plugin active, else what went wrong."""
    if ACTIVE_LINE in log_text:
        return None
    for line in log_text.splitlines():
        if "startlux prefix-bidir" in line and "NOT installed" in line:
            return line.strip()
    return (f"the log has no '{ACTIVE_LINE}' line: vLLM did not load the plugin (install this package in the vLLM "
            f"environment and keep {ENV}=1)")


@dataclass
class VLLMServers:
    """N vLLM servers for one folder (one per GPU), their logs and their lifetime."""
    model: str
    gpus: list
    base_port: int = 8001
    host: str = "127.0.0.1"
    log_dir: str = "vllm_logs"
    python: str = sys.executable
    served_name: str = "m"
    max_model_len: int | None = None        # default: see the module docstring
    gpu_memory_utilization: float = GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION
    quantization: str | None = None
    mtp: bool = True                        # MTP speculative decoding when the folder and the vLLM version allow it
    vllm_version: str | None = None         # default: read from `python`
    max_images: int = MAX_IMAGES            # images per request on vLLM 0.31 or later (0: text only)
    max_pixels: int = MAX_PIXELS
    procs: list = field(default_factory=list)

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.max_model_len is None:
            native = native_context(read_config(self.model)) if self.modern else None
            if native and self.bidirectional:
                native = min(native, INSTANT_MAX_MODEL_LEN)
            self.max_model_len = native or MAX_MODEL_LEN

    @property
    def modern(self) -> bool:
        """vLLM 0.31 or later."""
        v = parse_version(self.version)
        return v is not None and v >= STREAM_VERSION

    @property
    def bidirectional(self) -> bool:
        return read_prompt_attention(self.model) == "bidirectional"

    @property
    def version(self) -> str | None:
        """The vLLM version of `python` (read once)."""
        if self.vllm_version is None:
            self.vllm_version = vllm_version(self.python) or ""
        return self.vllm_version or None

    @property
    def prefix_caching(self) -> bool:
        """Prefix caching and chunked prefill on: an AutoThink (causal) folder on vLLM 0.31 or later."""
        return self.modern and not self.bidirectional

    @property
    def images(self) -> int:
        """Images per request the servers take: on vLLM 0.31 or later, for a folder with a vision tower."""
        return self.max_images if self.modern and vision_settings(read_config(self.model))[0] else 0

    @property
    def mtp_tokens(self) -> int:
        """MTP draft tokens per step: 3 when prefix caching is on, the folder holds MTP weights and `mtp` is set."""
        return MTP_DRAFT_TOKENS if self.mtp and self.prefix_caching and has_mtp_weights(self.model) else 0

    def settings(self) -> str:
        """One line on the version-dependent settings, for logs."""
        tail = f"; context {self.max_model_len} tokens; " + (
            f"up to {self.images} images per request" if self.images else "text only")
        if not self.prefix_caching:
            return (f"vLLM {self.version or '(version unknown)'}: prefix caching and chunked prefill off"
                    + (" (Instant folder)" if self.bidirectional else "") + tail)
        mtp = f"MTP speculative decoding with {self.mtp_tokens} draft tokens" if self.mtp_tokens else (
            "no MTP (switched off)" if not self.mtp else "no MTP (the folder holds no MTP weights)")
        return f"vLLM {self.version}: prefix caching and chunked prefill on, {mtp}" + tail

    @property
    def urls(self) -> list[str]:
        return [f"http://{self.host}:{self.base_port + i}" for i in range(len(self.gpus))]

    def log_path(self, i: int) -> str:
        return os.path.join(self.log_dir, f"vllm_{i}_gpu{self.gpus[i]}.log")

    def plan(self) -> list[tuple[list[str], dict]]:
        """(command, environment) of every server."""
        caching, mtp, images = self.prefix_caching, self.mtp_tokens, self.images
        return [(server_command(self.python, self.model, self.base_port + i, self.host, self.served_name,
                                self.max_model_len, self.gpu_memory_utilization, self.quantization, caching, mtp,
                                images, self.max_pixels),
                 server_env(str(g), self.bidirectional)) for i, g in enumerate(self.gpus)]

    def start(self) -> None:
        if self.bidirectional and not plugin_visible(self.python):
            raise RuntimeError(f"{self.model} is an Instant (prompt-bidirectional) folder, and {self.python} does not "
                               f"see the {PLUGIN_NAME} vLLM plugin: install this package in the Python that runs vLLM "
                               "(pip install -e . in that environment)")
        os.makedirs(self.log_dir, exist_ok=True)
        for i, (cmd, env) in enumerate(self.plan()):
            log = open(self.log_path(i), "w")
            self.procs.append(subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                               start_new_session=True))
            log.close()

    def wait_ready(self, timeout: float = 1800.0) -> None:
        """Wait until every server answers /health; raises when one exits or the time is up."""
        deadline = time.time() + timeout
        pending = set(range(len(self.procs)))
        while pending:
            for i in sorted(pending):
                if self.procs[i].poll() is not None:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"vLLM server {i} exited with code {self.procs[i].returncode}; last lines of "
                                       f"{self.log_path(i)}:\n{self.tail(i)}")
                try:
                    with urllib.request.urlopen(self.urls[i] + "/health", timeout=2) as r:
                        if r.status == 200:
                            pending.discard(i)
                except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError):
                    pass
            if pending and time.time() > deadline:
                raise RuntimeError(f"vLLM servers {sorted(pending)} not ready after {timeout:.0f} s")
            if pending:
                time.sleep(5)

    def check_plugin(self) -> None:
        """For an Instant folder: every server log must show the plugin active."""
        if not self.bidirectional:
            return
        for i in range(len(self.procs)):
            with open(self.log_path(i), errors="replace") as f:
                problem = plugin_problem(f.read())
            if problem:
                raise RuntimeError(f"vLLM server {i} ({self.log_path(i)}) would read the Instant folder causally: "
                                   f"{problem}")

    def tail(self, i: int, lines: int = 30) -> str:
        with open(self.log_path(i), errors="replace") as f:
            return "".join(f.readlines()[-lines:])

    def stop(self, grace: float = 60.0) -> None:
        """Terminate every server's process group (the API process and the engine processes it started), and kill
        what is left after `grace` seconds."""
        for p in self.procs:
            _signal_group(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        deadline = time.time() + grace
        for p in self.procs:
            try:
                p.wait(max(0.1, deadline - time.time()))
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                pass
            while _signal_group(p.pid, 0) and time.time() < deadline:
                time.sleep(0.5)
            _signal_group(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            p.wait()
        self.procs.clear()

    def up(self, timeout: float = 1800.0) -> None:
        """Start, wait until ready and check the plugin; stops every server when any of that fails."""
        try:
            self.start()
            self.wait_ready(timeout)
            self.check_plugin()
        except BaseException:
            self.stop()
            raise


def _signal_group(pgid: int, sig: int) -> bool:
    """Send `sig` to a process group; False when the group has no process left (signal 0 only checks)."""
    try:
        os.killpg(pgid, sig)
        return True
    except ProcessLookupError:
        return False



================================================
FILE: startlux_decide/loops.py
================================================
"""Loop detector for thoughts (the release uses this rule set, "version 3").

A decision model that has reached its answer sometimes cannot close its thought: it repeats the answer letter, a value,
a sentence or a whole paragraph until the token budget is used. The thought is generated in chunks, and between chunks
``looping(text)`` tells whether the END of the text is such a loop; ``loop_cut(text)`` returns the length of the
shortest prefix that already ends in the loop, so the reasoning and the first repeats are kept and the rest is dropped.

Rules, applied to the tail of the text:

* short   one unit of at most 80 characters repeated at least max(4, ceil(60 / unit length)) times (window of 400
          characters; every run of digits replaced by "#", checked with and without whitespace normalised)
* digits  the last 150 characters are at least 90% digits (a number that never ends)
* long    one unit of 81 to 400 characters repeated at least 3 times (window of 1,600 characters; digits replaced,
          whitespace normalised)
* lines   the last 20 non-empty lines are at most 8 different lines (spacing normalised, digits kept)
* words   the last 60 words are at most 6 different words (digits replaced)

At sampling temperature 0.6 many endless thoughts are not periodic: the model shuffles a handful of lines in random
order. The line and word rules catch those. The line rule keeps digits, so lines that differ only in their numbers
count as different lines; the periodic rules replace digits, so rows that repeat one pattern with changing numbers
are still a loop for them.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re

_DIG, _WS = re.compile(r"\d+"), re.compile(r"\s+")

SHORT_WINDOW, SHORT_MAX_UNIT, SHORT_MIN_REPEATS, SHORT_MIN_SPAN = 400, 80, 4, 60
DIGIT_RUN = 150
LONG_WINDOW, LONG_MAX_UNIT, LONG_MIN_REPEATS = 1600, 400, 3
LINES, MAX_DISTINCT_LINES = 20, 8
WORDS, MAX_DISTINCT_WORDS = 60, 6


def _periodic(t: str, lo: int, hi: int, min_rep: int, min_span: int) -> bool:
    """t ends in a unit of lo..hi characters repeated at least max(min_rep, ceil(min_span / unit)) times."""
    n = len(t)
    for p in range(lo, hi + 1):
        r = max(min_rep, -(-min_span // p))
        if n >= r * p and all(t[n - (j + 1) * p:n - j * p] == t[n - p:] for j in range(1, r)):
            return True
    return False


def few_lines(text: str) -> bool:
    """The last LINES non-empty lines are at most MAX_DISTINCT_LINES different lines (spacing normalised, digits
    kept)."""
    ls = [x for x in (_WS.sub(" ", y).strip() for y in text[-80 * LINES:].split("\n")) if x]
    return len(ls) > LINES and len(set(ls[-LINES:])) <= MAX_DISTINCT_LINES   # > LINES: the first line may be cut


def low_diversity(text: str) -> bool:
    """The last WORDS words are at most MAX_DISTINCT_WORDS different words (digits normalised)."""
    w = _DIG.sub("#", text[-12 * WORDS:]).split()
    return len(w) > WORDS and len(set(w[-WORDS:])) <= MAX_DISTINCT_WORDS


def looping(text: str) -> bool:
    """True when the text ends in a loop (see the module docstring)."""
    u = _DIG.sub("#", text[-SHORT_WINDOW:])
    for t in (u, _WS.sub(" ", u)):
        if _periodic(t, 1, SHORT_MAX_UNIT, SHORT_MIN_REPEATS, SHORT_MIN_SPAN):
            return True
    d = text[-DIGIT_RUN:]
    if len(d) == DIGIT_RUN and sum(c.isdigit() for c in d) >= 0.9 * DIGIT_RUN:
        return True
    v = _WS.sub(" ", _DIG.sub("#", text[-LONG_WINDOW:]))
    if _periodic(v, SHORT_MAX_UNIT + 1, LONG_MAX_UNIT, LONG_MIN_REPEATS, 0):
        return True
    return few_lines(text) or low_diversity(text)


def loop_cut(text: str) -> int | None:
    """Length of the shortest prefix that already ends in the loop, or None when the text does not end in one.
    Found by bisection to within 8 characters: inside a loop every longer prefix also ends in the loop."""
    if not looping(text):
        return None
    lo, hi = 0, len(text)
    while hi - lo > 8:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if looping(text[:mid]):
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid
    return hi

FILE: startlux_decide/modelcfg.py

"""What a model folder says about how to run it.

A StartLux-Decision folder holds the weights, the tokenizer, ``config.json`` and ``decision_config.json``:

* ``temperature_by_type``: read-out temperature per question type (choice, noul, score), fitted on held-out data;
* ``letter_token_ids``: the token ids of A to Z (checked against the tokenizer);
* ``max_options_per_pass``: 26, one letter per option;
* ``wide_choice``: {group, keep, residual} for choice lists over 26 options;
* ``prompt_attention``: "bidirectional" in Instant folders (their ``config.json`` carries the same value under
  ``jev_prompt_attention``, the key the training pipeline writes and the vLLM plugin reads);
* ``auto_think`` (optional, causal folders only): overrides of the built-in AutoThink defaults, see AutoThink;
* ``format``: "StartLux-Decision-v1" in the folders of the first release (v1).

From ``config.json`` the package also reads whether the folder has a vision tower (``vision_config``; images in the
evidence), its patch and merge sizes (``patch_size`` x ``spatial_merge_size`` pixels per image token side), and its
native context (``max_position_embeddings``, 262,144 tokens in these folders).

The kinds of models:

* Instant (prompt-bidirectional): the prompt is read with bidirectional attention in the full-attention layers, and
  the answer comes from one read-out. These models do not think.
* AutoThink (causal): one read-out first; when its top probability is below the gate, the model writes a thought
  and the decision is read again after it, and the two read-outs are mixed.
* v1 (causal; ``format`` "StartLux-Decision-v1" and no ``auto_think`` block): the first release, trained for one
  read-out. It answers in one pass by default (think_mode "never"); a request may still ask it to think, with the
  AutoThink settings, though v1 was not trained for that. Its prompts are those of v1.1.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import datetime
import json
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, fields
from typing import Any, Mapping

from .backends.base import Sampling
from .prompt import MAX_OPTIONS, TYPES

PROMPT_ATTENTION_KEY = "jev_prompt_attention"     # config.json key of the prompt attention mode (kept for old folders)
PROMPT_ATTENTION_MODES = ("causal", "bidirectional")
THINK_MODES = ("auto", "never", "always")
THINK_MODE_ALIASES = {"hybrid": "auto", "plain": "never", "think": "always"}
RELEASE_PREFIX = "Let me work through this carefully, step by step.\n"
V1_FORMAT = "StartLux-Decision-v1"                # decision_config.json "format" of the first release


def think_mode(value: Any) -> str:
    """"auto", "never" or "always" (the older names "hybrid", "plain" and "think" are accepted)."""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        value = THINK_MODE_ALIASES.get(value, value)
        if value in THINK_MODES:
            return value
    raise ValueError(f"think_mode must be one of {', '.join(THINK_MODES)} (or hybrid, plain, think), not {value!r}")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AutoThink:
    """Settings of the AutoThink path. The defaults are the release settings that produced the published numbers,
    except the gate: the published numbers used 0.9, the default is 0.6, which answers more requests in one pass.
    A folder may override any of them with an ``auto_think`` block in decision_config.json (same names)."""
    think_mode: str = "auto"            # auto: think when the first read-out is unsure; never; always
    gate: float = 0.6                   # think when the first read-out's top probability is below this
    mix: float = 0.75                   # final = (1 - mix) * first read-out + mix * read-out after the thought
    budget: int = 4096                  # most thought tokens
    prefix: str = RELEASE_PREFIX        # forced start of every thought
    tail_chars: int = 4000              # the read-out after the thought sees its last N characters; 0 = all
    chunk_tokens: int = 1024            # thought generated N tokens at a time, loop check in between; 0 = one call
    think_temperature: Mapping[str, float] = field(default_factory=lambda: {t: 1.0 for t in TYPES})
    sampling: Sampling = Sampling(temperature=0.6, top_p=0.95, top_k=20)


def _is_number(v: Any) -> bool:
    return isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool)


def _number(block: dict, key: str, lo: float, hi: float) -> float:
    v = block[key]
    if not _is_number(v) or not lo <= v <= hi:
        raise ValueError(f"auto_think.{key} must be a number in [{lo}, {hi}], not {v!r}")
    return float(v)


def _integer(block: dict, key: str, lo: int) -> int:
    v = block[key]
    if isinstance(v, bool) or not isinstance(v, int) or v < lo:
        raise ValueError(f"auto_think.{key} must be an integer >= {lo}, not {v!r}")
    return v


def parse_auto_think(block: dict | None) -> AutoThink:
    """The ``auto_think`` block of a decision_config.json (None or {} gives the defaults)."""
    if not block:
        return AutoThink()
    if not isinstance(block, dict):
        raise ValueError("auto_think must be an object")
    known = {f.name for f in fields(AutoThink)}
    unknown = sorted(set(block) - known)
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown auto_think settings {unknown}; known: {sorted(known)}")
    kw: dict = {}
    if "think_mode" in block:
        kw["think_mode"] = think_mode(block["think_mode"])
    for key in ("gate", "mix"):
        if key in block:
            kw[key] = _number(block, key, 0.0, 1.0)
    if "budget" in block:
        kw["budget"] = _integer(block, "budget", 1)
    for key in ("tail_chars", "chunk_tokens"):
        if key in block:
            kw[key] = _integer(block, key, 0)
    if "prefix" in block:
        if not isinstance(block["prefix"], str):
            raise ValueError("auto_think.prefix must be a string")
        kw["prefix"] = block["prefix"]
    if "think_temperature" in block:
        tt = block["think_temperature"]
        if not isinstance(tt, dict) or set(tt) - set(TYPES) or not all(_is_number(v) and v > 0 for v in tt.values()):
            raise ValueError(f"auto_think.think_temperature must map question types {TYPES} to positive numbers")
        kw["think_temperature"] = {k: float(v) for k, v in tt.items()}
    if "sampling" in block:
        s = block["sampling"]
        if not isinstance(s, dict) or set(s) - {"temperature", "top_p", "top_k"}:
            raise ValueError("auto_think.sampling must be an object with temperature, top_p and top_k")
        merged = {**AutoThink().sampling.__dict__, **s}
        t, top_p, top_k = merged["temperature"], merged["top_p"], merged["top_k"]
        if not (_is_number(t) and t > 0 and _is_number(top_p) and 0 < top_p <= 1 and isinstance(top_k, int)
                and not isinstance(top_k, bool) and top_k >= 0):
            raise ValueError("auto_think.sampling needs temperature > 0, 0 < top_p <= 1 and an integer top_k >= 0")
        kw["sampling"] = Sampling(float(t), float(top_p), top_k)
    return AutoThink(**kw)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelFolder:
    """The run settings of one model folder (see the module docstring)."""
    path: str
    prompt_attention: str
    temperature_by_type: Mapping[str, float]
    letter_token_ids: tuple | None
    wide_group: int
    wide_keep: int
    wide_residual: float
    auto_think: AutoThink | None        # None for Instant folders
    release_date: str
    format: str | None = None           # decision_config.json "format", if any
    v1: bool = False                    # a v1 folder: one pass by default (see the module docstring)
    vision: bool = False                # config.json has a vision tower: images can be part of the evidence
    image_factor: int = 32              # pixels per image token side (patch size x spatial merge size)
    native_context: int | None = None   # max_position_embeddings

    @property
    def kind(self) -> str:
        """"instant", "auto_think" or "v1"."""
        if self.prompt_attention == "bidirectional":
            return "instant"
        return "v1" if self.v1 else "auto_think"

    @property
    def bidirectional(self) -> bool:
        return self.prompt_attention == "bidirectional"

    def temperature(self, question_type: str) -> float:
        return self.temperature_by_type.get(question_type, 1.0)


def read_config(directory: str) -> dict:
    """DIRECTORY/config.json ({} when absent)."""
    path = os.path.join(str(directory), "config.json")
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        return {}
    with open(path) as f:
        return json.load(f)


def vision_settings(config: dict) -> tuple[bool, int]:
    """(the folder has a vision tower, pixels per image token side) from config.json."""
    vision = config.get("vision_config")
    if not isinstance(vision, dict):
        return False, 32
    return True, int(vision.get("patch_size", 16)) * int(vision.get("spatial_merge_size", 2))


def native_context(config: dict) -> int | None:
    """max_position_embeddings of the text model (top level or text_config)."""
    n = (config.get("text_config") or {}).get("max_position_embeddings", config.get("max_position_embeddings"))
    return n if isinstance(n, int) and not isinstance(n, bool) and n > 0 else None


def read_prompt_attention(directory: str) -> str:
    """The prompt attention mode in DIRECTORY/config.json ("causal" when the key or the file is absent)."""
    path = os.path.join(str(directory), "config.json")
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        return "causal"
    with open(path) as f:
        mode = json.load(f).get(PROMPT_ATTENTION_KEY, "causal")
    if mode not in PROMPT_ATTENTION_MODES:
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: {PROMPT_ATTENTION_KEY} must be one of {PROMPT_ATTENTION_MODES}, not {mode!r}")
    return mode


def load_model_folder(path: str) -> ModelFolder:
    """Read and check config.json and decision_config.json of a model folder."""
    cfg_path = os.path.join(path, "decision_config.json")
    if not os.path.isfile(cfg_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{path}: no decision_config.json; expected a local StartLux-Decision model folder")
    with open(cfg_path) as f:
        cfg = json.load(f)
    mode = read_prompt_attention(path)
    declared = cfg.get("prompt_attention", mode)
    if declared != mode:
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: prompt attention is {mode!r} in config.json but {declared!r} in "
                         "decision_config.json")
    temps = cfg.get("temperature_by_type")
    if not isinstance(temps, dict) or not all(k in TYPES and _is_number(v) and v > 0 for k, v in temps.items()):
        raise ValueError(f"{cfg_path}: temperature_by_type must map question types {TYPES} to positive numbers")
    if cfg.get("max_options_per_pass", MAX_OPTIONS) != MAX_OPTIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"{cfg_path}: max_options_per_pass must be {MAX_OPTIONS} (one letter per option)")
    letters = cfg.get("letter_token_ids")
    if letters is not None and (not isinstance(letters, list) or len(letters) != MAX_OPTIONS
                                or not all(isinstance(t, int) for t in letters)):
        raise ValueError(f"{cfg_path}: letter_token_ids must be a list of {MAX_OPTIONS} token ids")
    wide = cfg.get("wide_choice") or {}
    group, keep, residual = wide.get("group", 25), wide.get("keep", 3), wide.get("residual", 1e-3)
    if not (isinstance(group, int) and 2 <= group <= MAX_OPTIONS and isinstance(keep, int) and 1 <= keep <= group
            and isinstance(residual, (int, float)) and 0 <= residual < 1):
        raise ValueError(f"{cfg_path}: wide_choice needs 2 <= group <= {MAX_OPTIONS}, 1 <= keep <= group and "
                         "0 <= residual < 1")
    if mode == "bidirectional":
        if "auto_think" in cfg:
            raise ValueError(f"{cfg_path}: an Instant (prompt-bidirectional) folder does not think; remove auto_think")
        auto = None
    else:
        try:
            auto = parse_auto_think(cfg.get("auto_think"))
        except ValueError as e:
            raise ValueError(f"{cfg_path}: {e}") from None
    fmt = cfg.get("format")
    if fmt is not None and not isinstance(fmt, str):
        raise ValueError(f"{cfg_path}: format must be a string")
    v1 = mode == "causal" and fmt == V1_FORMAT and "auto_think" not in cfg
    if v1:
        auto = AutoThink(think_mode="never")    # trained for one pass; thinking only when a request asks for it
    released = cfg.get("release_date")
    if not isinstance(released, str):
        released = datetime.date.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(cfg_path)).isoformat()
    model_config = read_config(path)
    vision, factor = vision_settings(model_config)
    return ModelFolder(path=path, prompt_attention=mode, temperature_by_type={k: float(v) for k, v in temps.items()},
                       letter_token_ids=tuple(letters) if letters else None, wide_group=group, wide_keep=keep,
                       wide_residual=float(residual), auto_think=auto, release_date=released, format=fmt, v1=v1,
                       vision=vision, image_factor=factor, native_context=native_context(model_config))


def load_tokenizer(path: str):
    """The folder's Hugging Face tokenizer (needs transformers)."""
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    return AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(path)



================================================
FILE: startlux_decide/pipeline.py
